description: This file defines a mock class 'TestModuleMock' for unit testing, which inherits from 'firebolt::rialto::TestModule'. It uses Google Mock to mock methods related to IPC testing, specifically for testing protobuf RPC calls. The class provides mock implementations for various request and response methods, as well as utility methods to simulate responses and failures.

classes.name: TestModuleMock
classes.description: A mock class for 'firebolt::rialto::TestModule' used in unit testing to simulate IPC interactions.

methods.name: defaultReturn
methods.description: Simulates a successful RPC call by invoking the 'done' callback.

methods.name: failureReturn
methods.description: Simulates a failed RPC call by setting the controller to failed and invoking the 'done' callback.

methods.name: getSingleVarResponse
methods.description: Creates and returns a 'TestSingleVar' protobuf message with the specified 'var1' value.

methods.name: getMultiVarResponse
methods.description: Creates and returns a 'TestMultiVar' protobuf message with specified fields: 'var1', 'var2', 'var3', and 'var4'.
